name: Methods: The Illusion Murders
source:
A mystery story set in the world of Methods: The Detective Competition. Red July, an up-and-coming celebrity detective, is challenged by The Illusion Killer — a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions. However, in the course of solving the murder, Red July's famous method — which lets her instantly solve any crime — stops working. Now the race is on to stop the killer before it's too late!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个以《方法：侦探大赛》世界为背景的神秘故事。红七月是一位崭露头角的明星侦探，他受到了幻觉杀手的挑战——幻觉杀手是一个根据视错觉来谋杀的连环杀手。然而，在侦破谋杀案的过程中，红七月的著名方法——让她立即侦破任何犯罪——失效了。现在，我们必须在为时已晚之前阻止凶手！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636320/]Steam[/url]]
